data.name: 姉妹道中千両箱 : Edo Village Nightmare
data.detailed_description:
【Overview】

“Sisters' Journey: The Thousand-Ryo Chest: Edo Village Nightmare” is an exploration-based fantasy horror game set in a small Japanese village.

【Story】

An Edo-period countryside village, lined with several thatched-roof houses.

One day, the protagonist, a lonely girl named Onene, begins to sense the presence of her “older sister.”

With the villagers' help, Onene searches for [her sister's memories].

Was it a mistake in her memory, or did her sister truly exist...?

Following the villagers' advice,

One-ne-ne takes on occupational trials as challenges.

For each trial she clears,

she receives a magatama from the villagers.

The secret of “Anesama” felt through the magatama.

Who exactly is “Anesama”...?

One-ne-ne's trial to find “Anesama” begins.

【Game Features】

️A third-person 3D adventure game.

️You control the protagonist to clear trials.

Clear trials to receive magatama and advance the story.

[Day Mode Trials]

️Knead baked manju dough and bake it golden brown.

Cut soba noodles, boil them, and fry tempura.

Through this experience, you'll feel as if you've stepped back in time to the Edo period.

(*Only for the trial of baking the manju to a golden brown: press the key at the perfect moment. The rest proceeds automatically.)

[Night Mode Trial]

A warrior pursues the protagonist. Hide well and escape.

The thatched-roof house has a door that only opens at night.

Inside the room beyond that door lies...

An Edo-period slot machine?! Hit the jackpot! (Click the stop button to line up 7s or dog symbols.)

A picture-story-style animal silhouette quiz featuring animals soaking in hot springs. Guess the animal from the choices.

Once you've collected the magatama, ascend the stairs and head toward the maze floating in the sky.

The goal is just ahead.

【Game Features】

・Playtime: Approximately 2 hours

・Single-player only

・No multiple endings

・No controller settings

・No voice narration (only subtitles, BGM, and sound effects)

【Regarding Gameplay Streams】

Streaming and live commentary are highly encouraged!

Please include this store page URL in your stream description or similar section.

Translated with (free version)

data.short_description: "Big Sister..." For some reason, the lonely young girl Onene feels she must have an older sister. Who exactly is Onene's sister? The mountain village where she was born and raised has become a mysterious labyrinth. Onene's journey to find her sister has only just begun...
